step.cmd: In the Contracts pane, go to Start tab > Search > Search Agreements. It displays all the agreement ordered by modified date.
Enter the agreement name or number as the search keyword and click the Search icon ().

From the search results, click the Expand button () of the agreement you want to open. In the expanded description, click Documents. This opens the Agreement Details page that lists all the versions of the document.

To open an agreement document version, click the More button () next to the version and click Open. The document is opened in a new Microsoft Word instance. The document is automatically opened and locked by you (You'll see a message saying Document is locked by you). This means that your agreement is opened.
To regenerate the agreement, click the Work tab, click the More button (). This opens the Regenerate Agreement dialog box that lists all the templates.
Select the Regenerate option at the bottom of the window. Now, you can select the required template from the list available. By default, the previously used template will be selected.
Click Submit to regenerate agreement in new template. Click Cancel to return to agreement document.
To regenerate the agreement with redlines, click the Work tab, click More button () and click Regenerate. This opens the Regenerate Agreement dialog box that lists all the templates.
Select the Regenerate with Redlines option at the bottom of the window. By default, the previously used template will be selected, and the other templates will be disabled.
Click Submit to regenerate agreement in new template. Click Cancel to return to agreement document.

postreq.p: The regenerated document opens in a new Microsoft Word instance. Note that if the xa_disableautocheckout profile permission is set to true in Conga CLM, after regenerating the document, you will only see the confirmation message. The document will not open in a new instance. For more information on disabling auto check out, see Assigning Custom Permissions to User Profiles.
